# muumuu_domain (Data Source)

Looks up a domain of the account by ID or FQDN.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "muumuu_domain" "example" {
  fqdn = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fqdn` (String) The domain name (e.g. `example.com`). Exactly one of `id` and `fqdn` must be set.
- `id` (String) The ID of the domain (e.g. `MU00000001`). Exactly one of `id` and `fqdn` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `auto_renew_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the domain is renewed automatically.
- `contract_end_date` (String) The end date of the contract.
- `registrar` (String) The registrar of the domain.
- `setup_state` (String) The setup state of the domain.
- `sld` (String) The second-level domain.
- `state` (String) The state of the domain.
- `status_group` (String) The status group of the domain.
- `tld` (String) The top-level domain.
- `whois_proxy_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the WHOIS proxy is enabled.
